latest_cos_commentary.headline: 858 Partners is a small (2-10 employee) advisory and go-to-market firm for restaurant-tech vendors, founded by ex-Olo executives — not a direct product competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No direct product overlap; relevant because 858 Partners curates and recommends vendor shortlists (potentially including Genius's competitors) to restaurant brands evaluating tech stacks.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: The firm has run vendor showcases with NRN and industry conferences, giving it visibility into which POS/payments alternatives get surfaced to operators.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Treat as an industry influencer/curator rather than a vendor to displace; worth knowing if a prospect has engaged 858 Partners for tech-stack advice.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Very small firm (2-10 employees per LinkedIn); influence is likely narrow and concentrated within its own network.
